# Standalone I2 integration hooks. They never touch c2 locks/serial/electorates or native title ownership.
# Rite ROOT, called from an already authorized player migration chain before the native setter.
lyd_c3_before_rite_migration_effect = {
    save_scope_as = lyd_c3_migrating_rite
    faith = {
        every_faith_character = {
            limit = { rite = scope:lyd_c3_migrating_rite has_variable = lyd_c3_claim_rite var:lyd_c3_claim_rite = scope:lyd_c3_migrating_rite }
            remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_rite
            remove_variable = lyd_c3_claim_faith
            remove_character_flag = lyd_c3_claimant
        }
    }
}
# Faith ROOT. Read back actual head after a player-authorized migration/retirement; do not invent a successor.
lyd_c3_reconcile_faith_roles_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = lyd_c3_recognized_leader }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    exists = var:lyd_c3_recognized_leader
                    exists = religious_head
                    religious_head = var:lyd_c3_recognized_leader
                    var:lyd_c3_recognized_leader = { is_alive = yes faith = prev }
                }
            }
            remove_variable = lyd_c3_recognized_leader
            set_variable = { name = lyd_c3_vacancy value = 1 }
        }
    }
}
